name: Steve Stivers
bio: A Representative from Ohio; born in Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, March 24, 1965; graduated from Ripley-Union-Lewis High School, Ripley, Ohio, 1983; B.A., Ohio State University, Columbus, Ohio, 1989; M.B.A., Ohio State University, Columbus, Ohio, 1996; M.A., Army War College, Carlisle, Pa., 2012; Ohio Army National Guard, 1988-present; brigadier general; staff, Ohio state senate; professional advocate; businessman; member of the Ohio state senate, 2003-2008; unsuccessful candidate for election to the One Hundred Eleventh Congress in 2008; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Twelfth and to the five succeeding Congresses until his resignation on May 16, 2021 (January 3, 2011-May 16, 2021); president and chief executive officer, Ohio Chamber of Commerce, 2021-present.
